descriptions.w3d_d25g_camera_follow_800645b8: Moves a position toward its target: reads the +116 anchor vector and lowers it by the +56 height times the +108 speed; while the +40 blend is positive shows the marker, otherwise uses the +112 anchor. Within 0.3 on every axis it snaps and returns 1, hiding the marker once the blend is zero; otherwise it steps by the +136 rate and returns 0. Refreshes either way.
